name: Emperor Menelik II & Empress Taytu Monument

persona_scripts.material: Cast bronze monument adorned with gold-embroidered velvet imperial robes (Kaba).
persona_scripts.craft: Commissioned to honor the diplomatic, strategic, and military leadership of Emperor Menelik II and Empress Taytu Betul.
persona_scripts.usage: Empress Taytu led her own 6,000-strong force at Adwa and devised the vital strategy to cut off the enemy's water supply at Meqele.
